name: ManiSkill Panda PickCube Python recipe
summary: Grasp a cube and move it to a target with the official Panda motion planner.

license.scope: Upstream ManiSkill code; hub wrapper and metadata use the hub LICENSE.

observation.description: Reads ground-truth object poses, collision geometry and robot state directly from the simulator. Not an RGB-only policy.

hardware: Linux x86_64 CPU; SAPIEN wheel needs glibc >=2.28
Tested on Ubuntu 22.04 without a physical GPU, using Mesa 23.2.1 lavapipe Vulkan ICD for scene/material initialization
requirements.rendering: Output rendering disabled: render_backend=none, render_mode=None, state observations and CPU simulation. Pinned SAPIEN material initialization still needs a usable Vulkan ICD; verified CPU-only with Mesa lavapipe. Camera/graphics modes remain separate and unverified.
network: PyPI and dependency distributions; source package build hooks may execute
Official PyTorch CPU wheel index for the verified CPU-only setup
requirements.dependency_lock: Direct dependencies pinned; transitive dependencies resolved by pip and captured in the prepared project. No bit-for-bit environment guarantee.

completion.success_condition: PickCube-v1 env info.success is true after the upstream solver finishes, truncated is false, and 0 < elapsed_steps < max_episode_steps=1000; only then status is task_complete and exit is 0. The 1000-step motion-planning horizon is a Hub recipe condition, not the upstream default benchmark horizon. Success means cube at its goal and robot static; gripper release or placement on a support surface is not verified.
failure_modes: Required Linux mplib wheels unavailable on host OS
Motion planning reports failure or env info.success is false
Runtime exception or asset download failure
Episode truncated or elapsed_steps reaches the Hub 1000-step horizon
completion.stop_condition: Stop after one seed; no retries to conceal failures. Use an external 180-second process timeout.

evidence.result: New record version 1.1.0 explicitly sets a Hub 1000-step horizon and rejects truncated results. Runtime verification for this version is pending. Earlier immutable artifacts measured final objective success after the default 50-step horizon and do not establish completion within that default horizon.

contribution.instructions: Only actual reusable fixes. Public submission permission and a scoped pilot token are separate requirements. Submission opens a public internal draft PR; it is not publication.
